programmes.d: When the demon god Loki destroys the fortress of Valhalla and steals the Hammer of Invincibility, only the young hero Thor can protect Earth from armageddon.

Murphy is falling in love with his precious baby girl. Vasquez sneaks away for a secret meeting and Warren follows, learning a bit more about the mysterious bounty hunter who has somehow become an integral part of their team.

Driven by a horde onto sacred Native American grounds, our Heroes find two distinct halves of the same tribe trying to survive two separate ways. The "zunami" is bearing down on them all and their very survival at stake.

This action thriller takes a grim vision of the future where brutality is a virtue and mercy will cost your life. In this race, contestants participate in a cross-country road race where killing is how you win the game
When Air Force One goes down over the Bermuda Triangle, the Navy sends its best rescue team. But in saving the president, the team awakens a creature that threatens the entire eastern seaboard.

Citizen Z finds himself battling thawed zombies and unable to communicate with the team. In a desperate attempt to help our Heros out on their quest to get to the CDC, Citizen Z issues an on air bounty for Murphy.
In February 1942 US forces engaged an unidentified flying object above Los Angeles. Now almost 70 years later, the alien invaders have returned.
When a commercial airliner is trapped within a ring of erupting volcanoes, the passengers and crew must find a way to survive - without landing.

Three strangers earn their way into the team and take a keen interest in Murphy. As their interest in Murphy takes a deadly turn, he must use his emerging zombie qualities to save the rest of our heroes.
Warren's Apocalyptic Dream of a Black Rainbow sends our heroes on a mysterious new mission to save the Apocalypse from something even worse.

The world's greatest killing machine is three times as deadly when a mutated shark threatens a cruise ship. As the shark eats its way from one end of the ship to the next, the passengers fight the deadly predator using anything they can find.
Three kayakers fight for their lives when a great white shark traps them on a small, sinking island.
Six friends throw a party that goes wrong, five years later they gather again and endure far more horror.

When a Semester at Sea ship is sunk by a mutated two-headed shark, the survivors escape to a deserted atoll. But when it starts flooding, the coeds are no longer safe from the double jaws of the monster.
In the future, glacial melting has covered 98% of earth. Sharks dominate the planet, led by a mutated alpha shark, as human survivors live in terror.
An arcade manager discovers her brother has been transported into a video game, and she has to enter it with her friends to save him.
